secrets.name: APPS_SCRIPT_URL
secrets.description: Google Apps Script Web App /exec URL — the backend for products, orders, and CRM (Google Sheets). Obtain from the deployed Code.gs web app in your Google Apps Script editor (Deploy > Manage deployments).

secrets.name: APPS_SCRIPT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Token sent with each Apps Script request for authentication. Set in your Code.gs deployment.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key powering the Noah-AI (נועה-AI) chat assistant. Obtain from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

secrets.name: LOVABLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Alternative Lovable API key for the AI chat assistant (used if GEMINI_API_KEY is absent). Obtain from your Lovable project settings.
